blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Puerto Rico’s Jennifer Barreto became the first Mrs. to be crowned Miss Universe at the 75th edition of the international pageant held on her home turf on Tuesday night (Wednesday morning in Manila). The 27-year-old psychologist made history by winning the title since the Miss Universe Organization opened its doors to mothers […]...
